high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "earthneeds," located in Brooklyn, New York. The post features a display board titled "HOW LONG UNTIL IT'S GONE?" which illustrates the decomposition times of various items commonly found as litter. Content of the Display Board: The board is divided into sections, each containing different types of waste materials along with their estimated time to decompose. Items include: Paper: 2-6 weeks Cardboard: 3 months Orange Peel: 2 years
